title: WhoisFreaks
description: Ingests WhoisFreaks commercial domain threat intelligence (malware, phishing, spam) and newly registered domain (NRD) feeds into OpenCTI. Supports per-feed enable/disable aligned with subscription tiers, day-level incremental import with mid-day offset checkpoints for multi-million-record daily files, and streamed CSV pagination against the WhoisFreaks stream API.
short_description: WhoisFreaks threat feeds and newly registered domains for OpenCTI.
